definitions.gloss: to pile up; to accumulate; to build up
definitions.explanation: For things to stack up or accumulate over time, either physically (objects) or abstractly (experience, stress, effort).

examples.japanese: ⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れ：03518_tsukare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{積|つ}み{重|かさ}なって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{積|つ}み{重|かさ}なって、⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{成果|せいか}→成果：06745_seika⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Small efforts accumulate and become great results.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{不満|ふまん}→不満：02497_fuman⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{積|つ}み{重|かさ}なり、ついに⟦{爆発|ばくはつ}→爆発：03575_bakuhatsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Years of frustration had piled up and finally exploded.

notes:
A compound verb combining ⟦{積|つ}む→積む：02294_tsumu⟧ (to pile up) and ⟦{重|かさ}なる→重なる：02038_kasanaru⟧ (to overlap, to stack). The intransitive form — things accumulate on their own or over time. Commonly used both for physical stacking and metaphorical accumulation of experiences, effort, stress, or grievances.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{積|つ}み{重|かさ}なる — experience accumulates
- ⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{積|つ}み{重|かさ}なる — efforts build up
- ⟦{疲労|ひろう}→疲労：13603_hirou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{積|つ}み{重|かさ}なる — fatigue piles up
- ⟦{不満|ふまん}→不満：02497_fuman⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{積|つ}み{重|かさ}なる — frustration builds up

TRANSITIVE PAIR:
- ⟦{積|つ}み{重|かさ}ねる→積み重ねる：06235_tsumikasaneru⟧ — to pile up, to accumulate (transitive); used when someone deliberately builds up something

SIMILAR WORDS:
- たまる — to accumulate, to build up; more casual and general
- ⟦{蓄積|ちくせき}する→蓄積する：25358_chikusekisuru⟧ — to accumulate; more formal/technical
- ⟦{重|かさ}なる→重なる：02038_kasanaru⟧ — to overlap, to pile up; one of the component verbs, less emphasis on gradual accumulation
